title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Ivan Matveev and Siu Chi Nicholas Cheng in the M15 Islamabad, Qualifying, originally scheduled for November 29, 2026 at 12:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Ivan Matveev' if Ivan Matveev advances against Siu Chi Nicholas Cheng.

This market will resolve to 'Siu Chi Nicholas Cheng' if Siu Chi Nicholas Cheng advances against Ivan Matveev.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 13, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
